description: Read a published course list by its public ID, including the website link, courses in website order, campuses and public advisor notes. Recommendations reflect the advisor’s opinion. Use get_course with a listed CRICOS course code for current fees, English requirements or intakes. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

id.description: Public list ID from search_course_lists, e.g. "C976".

name: get_course_list
title: Get a published course list
